avis.texte: I absolutely love cleansing oils and especially brands that peach lily offers. Cleans your skin so well without leaving it oily or too dry.

This oil cleanser is golden! It rubs on incredibly smooth and washes off exquisitely, leaving my skin feeling clean without the oilyness! This is for sure, my absolute favorite cleanser- especially in the summer when I'm using so much sun protection on my face, it removes the all the oils from my sweat and the spf immaculately!

avis.titre: Best cleansing oil on the market!
avis.texte: If you have a teenager who is struggling with blackheads, you might want to have them try adding this to their daily/nightly skincare routine. Even if all they do is wash and moisturize, this will be the one step that will help unclog everything. DRY hands, DRY face, less than half a pump is all you need!! Really work it in, as though it were face soap, paying special attention to t-zone and nose. My teens do this step right before getting in the shower.

avis.titre: A little goes a long with
avis.texte: A little goes a long with this oil cleanser, one of my favorites for when my skin is extra dry in winter!
I'm not usually too sensitive to fragrance unless it's overwhelming. This smelled so bad I use as a hand wash.
Not my favorite smell on a product, but definitely not bad, either. Love the texture and cleansing, face is clear, breakout-free, and comfortable. Good price for the product.

avis.titre: I have an oily zone but t
avis.texte: I have an oily zone but the rest of my skin is pretty normal, a little sensitive. I was excited to try this, Unfortunately this oil cleanser wasn't for me, it made my face feel stripped and had a burning sensation after using.
Super hydrating, and rinses off and doesn't leave me feeling greasy even without an extra cleanser afterwards.
This cleanser feels very light on the skin and very refreshing. The scent is mild and smells really good!

LOVE IT! I started using it a couple of weeks ago and I'm already in love. Immediate impact on my blackheads. Rinses clean which is great. No oily residue. I've used a lot of oil cleansers and this one is the top.
Nice oil. It feels like you didn't wash it off but it just moisturizes that well. So if you need a beginner oil this is it.
I love this product and will definitely buy again. I use this followed by the Snail Rescue Cleanser and they go really nicely together. My skin has felt much brighter and more radiant looking.

This oil cleanser removes all of my oil impurities, even after a day out sailing when I've put lots of sunscreen on my face, and then biking home in traffic with all the gas coming from the cars and buses. My face feels so refreshed and cleansed after using this cleanser. And there's such a gentle citrusy smell to it that makes it even more delightful!
Glad I added this for a double cleanse. seems to have really helped with the sebum on my nose.
This cleansing oil easily melts into your skin! It has no strong fragrance smells just fine. I use it every day on my face, and it has highly improved the dryness.

I absolutely love this oil cleanser. This is the second bottle I have bought. I even bought my daughter one because she kept using mine! The cleanser removes make up well and does not leave your skin feeling greasy or dry.
This product has me glowing. It's such an affordable product but works like a high end one. I love how it leaves my skin feeling and looking.
This product has helped keep my skin clean and clear since I started using it!
This cleanser really works! When I use it, I can see the sebaceous filaments coming out. It makes my skin feel so clean. However, as someone with sensitive skin, the cleanser is sometimes drying.

avis.titre: Cleans well, but not good for sensitive skin
avis.texte: Skin is very soft after first use, but after the second day my skin started to feel tight, itchy and became very irritated. It took a week to calm down. I really wanted to like this product so I tried again and the same thing happened after the second day. I fear I may be allergic to one of the ingredients. It may work for people who do not have sensitive skin.

I really like this cleansing oil so far! I just got it two weeks ago and I'm trying it after using some other oil based cleansers, but so far I'm liking this one the most. I can tell it's making a difference with my pores and blackheads, and I like the light scent and how fresh and clean my face feels afterwards.
Love how clean it gets my face without drying out my skin. And has reduces the size of my pores helping to get rid of my blackheads. Washes off clean not leaving an oily feeling.
I've tried a few different products to remove my makeup and this helps it melt off. I use this and a water/gel cleanser after and I love it

My blackheads are slowly diminishing. I love the oil cleansing method for my face and smells amazing! A super clean feeling but not drying is what I love!!!!!!!! I definitely recommend it to everyone to double cleanse!

This cleaning oil has become an absolute must in not only my skincare routine, but in my teenage children's as well! When I saw how well it cleansed my skin, leaving zero residue behind, and also mildly exfoliating leaving my skin so soft, I knew I had to get it for my teens. My kids use it right before they jump into the shower. It has really cleared up my son's blackheads! With dry hands and face, about 1/2 a pump and clean your face, spending a little extra time in any congested area. Then add a bit of water to your hands, rub together and wash your face and then rinse with cool water. I follow up with the gel cleanser. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine!
Smells string of essential oil, I would not recommend for sensitive as it can be irritating.
Takes makeup off quickly, emulsifies easily, and leaves no oily residue

I have dry and sensitive skin, but I haven't found any problems with this cleanser! I love how clean my face feels after using it, and i have started to notice a reduction in blackheads around my nose and chin!
Smells like oranges. Feels so nice on my face, like it's melting my impurities. And leaves no oily residue once you rinse it off. Can you ask for a better cleaning oil? Don't think so.
I like this cleanser as one part of my double cleanse. It get all the makeup off and I don't feel dried out and tight after.
So surprised that the oil didn't feel heat or guey. I love the way it feels & cleanses.

The claim that this product reduces blackheads is absolutely true! I. In just two weeks of using if using ma:nyo, my skin (especially the nose area) has smaller pores and almost no blackheads. I'm absolutely in love with it. It also removes make up well, and any residual eye make up it doesn't remove, I clear away with Peach & Lily's Power Calm Hydrating Gel Cleanser.
Bottle is so pretty! Smells wonderful and works like a charm. Super smooth, no residue and feels great!
Is cleanser has been helping me out with my acne a lot more than I was expecting. I'm quite pleased.
have been using this product for a year! it works great as a toner
I used this for the 1st time last night and In the morning I can see the lightness of my redness from rosacea!!! This is my 1st time using Azelaic Acid and I am impressed!!

avis.titre: Working through first bottle, v happy so far
avis.texte: I've been using the cosrx AHA and BHA power liquids for some time and wanted to increase the acids in my life…Currently applying on alternate evenings, with retinoid on other nights. Saw great results with first couple uses, and am hoping for anti-aging benefits with continued use.
